lines: ὡς δὲ καὶ ὧλλοι οἱ περιπεμφθέντες παρῆσαν φέροντες τοὺς χρησμούς, ἐνθαῦτα ὁ Κροῖσος ἕκαστα ἀναπτύσσων ἐπώρα τῶν συγγραμμάτων, τῶν μὲν δὴ οὐδὲν προσίετό μιν·

n7323.source: Euripides, Iphigenia Taurica, ed. Gilbert Murray, Oxford 1913 (Perseus)
lines: Θόας ἄναξ γῆς τῆσδε ποῦ κυρεῖ βεβώς;

n7323.source: Plutarchus, Demetrius, ed. Bernadotte Perrin, Cambridge, Mass. 1920 (Perseus)

n7323.source: Oppianus, Halieutica, ed. A. W. Mair, London 1928 (Perseus)

n7323.source: Philostratus, Imagines, ed. Carl Ludwig Kayser, Leipzig 1871 (Perseus)

n7323.source: Xenophon, Anabasis, ed. Edgar Carew Marchant, Oxford 1904 (Perseus)

n7323.source: Plutarchus, Pelopidas, ed. Bernadotte Perrin, Cambridge, Mass. 1917 (Perseus)

n7355.source: Herodotus, Historiae, ed. A. D. Godley, Cambridge 1920 (Perseus)
